name: respond-first-skips-slash-command
description: Slash-command turn does not trigger respond-first denial even though the assistant calls a tool with no text preface. The prior real user message has already been answered in the previous assistant turn. FLAKY (in fixture-bug/ for this reason): observed 1/7 runs failing - flaked once when tool-approve denied with "Git write operation denied", i.e. the gate-reasoning LLM misclassified a plain `git status` as a write op. The other 6/7 runs (including 5 consecutive dedicated re-runs) allowed correctly. The intended behavior under test passes most of the time; the bug is the non-determinism of the gate-reasoning LLM occasionally hallucinating a write classification on a read-only git command.

content.text: Real reasons: the mood prompt is too keyword-anchored, and predictions overwrite per turn with no escalation memory.
